whenToUse: An indie game studio site with key art, trailer, pillars, dev diary, media page and press kit.
Studios that need copy buttons and downloadable press assets.
avoidWhen: A band or musician — use site-artist-01.
A mobile app landing — use site-app-01.
a11y: Trailers are click-to-load; copy and download results use aria-live; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Replace empty alt on screenshots with descriptions of each scene.
